name: worn
//: pnpm.overrides: fast-uri and @fastify/busboy are transitive (fast-uri via ajv/fast-json-stringify/@fastify/ajv-compiler, busboy via @fastify/multipart) and every parent already allows the fixed versions but the lockfile kept the old ones.
fast-uri <3.1.7: SSRF / host confusion advisories. @fastify/busboy <3.2.1: multipart DoS advisory. Drop these once the lockfile resolves fixed versions on its own.

shell-quote <1.11.0 has a critical quote() command injection. It is in the production trees through gel (drizzle-orm optional peer, never imported: we use drizzle-orm/postgres-js) in the API and workers, and through react-native -> react-devtools-core / launch-editor (dev tooling) in mobile. 1.12.0 is a compatible minor.
minimatch@9>brace-expansion: @sentry/node (API and workers at runtime) -> minimatch 9 -> brace-expansion 2.1.1, which has several DoS advisories fixed in 2.1.7.
nanoid@3: expo-router (in the app bundle) resolves nanoid 3.3.12, which has two infinite-loop advisories fixed by 3.3.18; 3.x is the same API.
